title: Finish the bus class
prompt: A `Bus` has a `Route` and a count of `Riders` that starts at 0. `GetOn(int count)` should add count to `Riders`. `GetOff()` should lower `Riders` by 1, but never below 0. Both methods are empty in the starter. Fill them in.
hints: Inside a method of the class, Riders is this bus's own count. What should it be after GetOn(2) and then GetOn(3)?
GetOn must keep the count the bus already has and add to it.
In GetOn, set Riders to Riders + count. In GetOff, subtract 1 only when Riders is greater than 0.
checkLabels: A new bus must keep the route it was given.
A new bus must start with 0 riders.
After 3 get on, Riders must be 3.
After 2 get on and then 3 more, Riders must be 5.
After 3 get on and 1 gets off, Riders must be 2.
More riders getting off than are on must leave Riders at 0.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Replaces the count with each group getting on instead of adding to it.

feedback: Follow the failing sequence of calls on one bus and write down Riders after each call.
